messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not take in higher doses or more often than prescribed"
set: ["do not take in higher doses or more often than prescribed", "do not take more or less or more often than prescribed", "do not take more than prescribed", "do not take more or less than prescribed", "do not take more than prescribed dose", "do not take more than recommended", "do not take more than recommended dose", "dose should not be higher than prescribed", "do not take more than 400 mg in one day", "more likely at higher doses", "higher doses", "do not take extra doses between scheduled doses", "patients taking higher than recommended doses", "never take in larger amounts or for longer than prescribed", "do not take two doses at once", "doses are usually changed no more often than once a week"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
